verses.1: In the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim,
verses.2: these kings went to war against Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, that is, Zoar.
verses.3: All these kings joined forces in the Valley of Siddim, that is, the Salt Sea.
verses.4: For twelve years they had served Chedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.5: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings allied with him came and defeated the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh-kiriathaim,
verses.6: and the Horites in their hill country of Seir, as far as El-paran on the border of the wilderness.
verses.7: Then they turned back and came to En-mishpat, that is, Kadesh, and defeated all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites who were living in Hazazon-tamar.
verses.8: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, that is, Zoar, marched out and drew up their battle lines in the Valley of Siddim
verses.9: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar — four kings against five.
verses.10: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of bitumen pits, and as the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some fell into them, while the rest escaped to the hill country.
verses.11: The four kings seized all the goods and food of Sodom and Gomorrah and went on their way.
verses.12: They also took Lot, the son of Abram's brother, who was living in Sodom, along with his possessions, and went their way.
verses.13: One who had escaped came and told Abram the Hebrew, who was living by the oaks of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and Aner. These were allies of Abram.
verses.14: When Abram heard that his kinsman had been taken captive, he called out his 318 trained men, born in his household, and went in pursuit as far as Dan.
verses.15: He divided his forces against them by night, he and his servants, and defeated them and pursued them to Hobah, north of Damascus.
verses.16: He brought back all the possessions, and also brought back his kinsman Lot with his possessions, along with the women and the other people.
verses.17: After Abram returned from defeating Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, the king of Sodom went out to meet him at the Valley of Shaveh, that is, the King's Valley.
verses.18: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.
verses.19: He blessed Abram and said, "Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.
verses.20: And blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand!" Then Abram gave him a tenth of everything.
verses.21: The king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give me the people, but keep the goods for yourself."
verses.22: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, "I have lifted my hand in oath to the LORD, God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,
verses.23: that I will not take so much as a thread or a sandal strap or anything that belongs to you, so that you will never be able to say, 'I made Abram rich.'
verses.24: I will accept nothing except what my men have eaten and the share that belongs to the men who came with me — Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their share."

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
